1179.a:
Each identifier field makes up part of the 
 history message field, which is generated with each system process. Each 
 field's value will depend on the type of process history record.   Below are some of the values that the system 
 stores in each Identifier Field:

1193.a: Include Closed Receipts Toggle This toggle indicates if you want to include closed receipts (along with open receipts) in a search  on the Receipt Insight screen.

1196.a: Include Closed Work Toggle This toggle indicates if you want to include closed work in a search on the Work Insight screen.

1197.a: Include Confirmed Shipments Toggle You can use this toggle to indicate that you want the system to also display confirmed shipment records in an insight screen search. Note that "confirmed" in this instance is defined as shipments with a status greater than or equal to load confirm pending.

1199.a: Include Empty Locations Toggle You can use this setting to indicate that you want the system to also display empty location records in an insight screen search.

1200.a: Include File Checkbox If this checkbox is selected, the system will attach the data file (in .csv format) associated to a notification (such as an email message or SMS text).

1201.t: Include Freight Charge In Amount Checkbox
1201.a:
This checkbox indicates how the system will send the freight charge 
 of a container to Progistics. If this check box is selected, the system 
 will make two "calls" to Progistics. The first call will retrieve 
 the freight charge from Progistics. The second will pass the container

1203.t: Include In Item Balance Upload Field
1203.a:
Include In Item Balance Upload Field This field indicates that you want to upload item balance data for items 
 that are in a particular location class. When this field is inactive, 
 the inventory in all locations of this location class will not be included 
 in the uploaded data.

1204.a:
You can use this checkbox to indicate whether or not you want the system 
 to include inactive records in the results of a field lookup window search. 
 If this checkbox is selected, the system will display all records regardless

1205.t: Include In Process Work Orders Toggle
1205.a: Include In Process Work Orders Toggle This toggle indicates if you want to include those work orders that are currently being processed in a search on the Work Order Insight screen.

1206.a: Include In Process Work Toggle This toggle indicates if you want to include those work units that are currently being processed in a search on the Work Insight screen.

1207.a: Include Open Manifests Toggle When only 'Include open manifests' toggle is on in the Filter Pane of Manifest Insight Screen, the system displays the records with only Manifest status open and Transmit status blank.

1208.a: Include Open Work Toggle This field displays all the work units when the work condition is in open status in the Work Insight Screen.

1209.a: Include Released Plans Toggle If this toggle is turned on in the filter pane, the released plans will also get displayed in the search results.

1210.a: Include Released Work Orders Toggle A work order is released when the released date time is populated and not released when the field is null. The default value of this toggler on the Work Order Insight screen is Off.

1211.a: Include Replenishment Requests Toggle This toggle shows an ON/OFF switch to include/exclude the replenishment requests from the Filter Pane search of Immediate Needs Insight records.

1212.a: Include Scheduled Work Orders Toggle This toggle indicates if you want to include those work orders that have not yet been started. These must be released before you can begin processing them.

1213.a: Include Shipment Allocation Requests Toggle This toggle shows an ON/OFF switch to include/exclude the shipment allocation requests from the Filter Pane search of Immediate Needs Insight records.

1214.t: Include Shipment Short Pick Requests Toggle
1214.a: Include Shipment Short Pick Requests Toggle This toggle shows an ON/OFF switch to include/exclude the shipment short pick requests from the Filter Pane search of Immediate Needs Insight records.

1215.a: Include Transmission Files Toggle When only 'Include transmission files' toggle is on in the Filter Pane of Manifest Insight Screen, the system displays those records for which the Transmit status is not null.

1216.a: Include Work Order Requests Toggle This toggle shows an ON/OFF switch to include/exclude the work order requests from the Filter Pane search of Immediate Needs Insight records.

1259.a: Internal Work Order Line Number Field This field indicates the internal work order line number associated with a specific work order which is created by the database when inserting the record. It helps to determine the open and in process work for the selected work order line.
